constants.LIST_ITEMS_RESULT_SQL:
WITH t0 AS (SELECT "id", "name", "price", "owner_id", "created_at", "id" AS __ord FROM "items"),
t1 AS (SELECT "id", "name", "price", "owner_id", "created_at", ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ("id" IS NULL), "id", __ord) AS __ord FROM t0),
t2 AS (SELECT "id", "name", "price", "created_at", __ord FROM t1),
t3 AS (SELECT "id", "name", "price", "created_at", __ord FROM t2 ORDER BY __ord LIMIT :p_n OFFSET :p_skip)
SELECT f."id", f."name", f."price", f."created_at", (f.__ord IS NOT NULL) AS __in_page, n.__total FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS __total FROM t2) AS n LEFT JOIN t3 AS f ON 1 ORDER BY f.__ord
